slot.brief: Among given species, identify the one with a different hybridisation/geometry than the rest (odd-one-out by shape).

stem: Which species has a central atom with a different hybridisation and molecular geometry from the other three?

verdicts.working: CCl₄, SiH₄, and CH₄ have sp³ central atoms and tetrahedral geometry. BF₃ has an sp² central atom and trigonal planar geometry.

working:
